description: Event catalogue for the Correspondent Bank Relationship Setup journey. Introduces 2 events: EVT-163 and EVT-164. Both events published by SVC-015 (Compliance Core, CAP-005).

events.name: CorrespondentEddCompleted
events.trigger: FATF R13 EDD completed with no sanctions hit. Senior Management approval obtained per MLR 2017 R34. CorrespondentRelationship status = approved.

consumers.action: Intra-capability: set up ongoing AML monitoring for new correspondent relationship.
Cross-capability: create nostro account for correspondent relationship.
Cross-capability: register correspondent BIC in payment routing table; enable currency corridor.
Write immutable EDD and SM approval record (MLR 2017 R34 evidence).

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-relationship ordering via relationship_id partition key on topic compliance.correspondent.
events.worm_rationale: EDD completion and SM approval record is MLR 2017 R34 audit evidence — immutable for FCA enforcement defence.

events.name: CorrespondentOnboarded
events.trigger: Nostro account created in SVC-007, correspondent BIC registered in SVC-010, and test SWIFT message successfully exchanged. CorrespondentRelationship status = active.
events.journey_phase_name: Nostro Account Setup and SWIFT Registration
events.ordering_guarantees: Per-relationship ordering. CorrespondentOnboarded must follow CorrespondentEddCompleted for same relationship_id.
events.worm_rationale: Correspondent onboarding record is the definitive MLR 2017 R34 evidence that the relationship was properly established.
